recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下，淋巴竇內充滿大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡染而呈泡沫／空泡狀，核圓、空泡狀並有小核仁，其間夾雜小淋巴球與漿細胞，部分淋巴球似位於組織球內；配合臨床為巨大淋巴結病，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated to foamy cytoplasm
Round vesicular histiocyte nuclei with small nucleoli and bland cytology
Numerous admixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells, some apparently within histiocyte cytoplasm
Fibrous septa and denser lymphoplasmacytic areas at the right edge
No necrosis, eosinophil clusters, or atypical mitoses
describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli. Many small lymphocytes and plasma cells are intermixed, and some lymphocytes appear to lie within histiocyte cytoplasm, suggesting emperipolesis. Fibrous bands and denser lymphoplasmacytic areas are present at the periphery, without necrosis or significant atypia. Findings are suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease, with S100 positivity and CD1a negativity needed for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Infection-associated foamy histiocytosis (e.g., mycobacterial spindle cell pseudotumor, Whipple disease)
ddx.vs: Infectious foamy histiocytes contain organisms on AFB or PAS stains and are S100-negative.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei, eosinophils are prominent, and the cells are CD1a/langerin-positive.
ECD shows foamy histiocytes with Touton giant cells and fibrosis, are S100-negative or weak, and frequently harbor BRAF V600E.
